title: Model-Agnostic Gender Bias Control for Text-to-Image Generation via Sparse Autoencoder

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the gender of generated images using BLIP-2 visual question answering ('Does the person look like a male or a female?') to compute mismatch rates for gender-specific occupational prompts and a skew metric that measures the distribution imbalance of male and female images for gender-neutral occupational prompts.
